Hi Sofia / Brightline legal team —

Thanks again for the helpful call this morning. We made good progress on the commercial terms and I wanted to outline the remaining items so we can get the DPA executed this week:

1) Transfer mechanism: Brightline requested SCCs + a UK IDTA addendum. Please confirm whether you prefer a combined addendum (SCCs appended + UK language) or separate attachments. Redwood's legal prefers a short UK addendum that references the SCCs to reduce duplication.

2) Transfer impact language (TIA): You asked for our assessment. I've attached a 1-page TIA_Summary_Mar2026.pdf — Marcus (cc) prepared it. If you need additional details about logging/diagnostics data flows, flag that and we can add a short paragraph.

3) Subprocessors: Attached is our current subprocessor list (Brightline_Subprocessors_20260323.csv). If you need SOC2 reports for any specific subprocessors we can surface those via our security portal.

4) Redlines & execution: Karthik will run through the substantive redlines. We prefer DocuSign, but if you only accept Adobe Sign we can accommodate — please confirm. Proposed target: Redwood signs and returns by Fri 3/26; Brightline countersigns by Tue 3/30.

Attachments: DPA_Redlines_v3.docx (internal redline), Brightline_Subprocessors_20260323.csv, TIA_Summary_Mar2026.pdf

Next step: Sofia, can you confirm (a) preferred execution method, (b) whether you want a standalone UK IDTA or a combined addendum, and (c) any remaining substantive redlines you expect?

Best,
Rachel Kim

Subject: Re: Next steps to finalize DPA + international transfer addendum for Brightline Health

Rachel —

Appreciate the quick recap and the attachments. Our legal team reviewed Marcus's TIA summary — very helpful. A few clarifications from our side after an initial pass of your redlines:

- Execution: Brightline prefers DocuSign.

- Transfer approach: We typically ask for the SCCs with a short UK IDTA addendum. A separate, cross-referencing addendum is fine — as long as the UK language specifically covers onward transfers to subprocessors and includes the UK Supplementary Measures language we follow.

- Clause-specific asks: Our team has three items we'd like redlined in the DPA (I'll summarize now and send a formatted redline shortly):
  1) Narrower audit notice window — we usually require 10 business days for routine audits.
  2) Clarify processor-to-processor obligations for function-calling telemetry (logging retained for troubleshooting only; delete after 30 days unless incident).
  3) Subprocessor onboarding: include the right to receive notification and a 15 day review window if we identify a high-risk subprocessor.

I'll attach the redline as a Doc: Brightline_DPA_Redline_20260325.docx and email our security contact for SOC2 evidence requests.

I'll follow up in a separate email with the DocuSign envelope link once our legal ops queues the signature.

Thanks —
Sofia
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Brightline Health
sofia.morales@brightlinehealth.com

Subject: Re: Next steps to finalize DPA + international transfer addendum for Brightline Health

Sofia —

Thanks for the summary. Quick responses inline to your three items and a couple of Redwood proposals to keep the agreement executable: 

1) Audit notice window: We can accept 10 business days for routine audits, provided audits are scoped to security evidence (SOC2/ISO) and limited frequency (max once per 12 months) — please see redline in DPA_Redlines_v3.docx.

2) Logging/telemetry: Redwood's runtime captures ephemeral diagnostics and aggregated metrics. We can commit to retention-for-troubleshooting of up to 30 days and delete/aggregate thereafter except where required for incident response or lawful obligation. We'll add explicit language that telemetry is not used to build personal profiles.

3) Subprocessor onboarding: Accept 15 day review notice for any newly engaged subprocessor identified as "high risk" by Brightline, with the right to escalate to a security call. For routine subprocessors we will provide notice 30 days prior to engagement.

Transfer mechanism: Redwood prefers the SCCs as the primary transfer instrument with a short UK IDTA addendum that references the SCCs and includes the UK supplementary measures clause. We'll provide a marked-up UK addendum (see attached).

Execution flow: DocuSign is fine. Karthik here — Redwood is prepared to send a DocuSign envelope that includes: (a) DPA with redlines accepted, (b) SCCs as Appendix A, (c) UK IDTA addendum as Appendix B. Proposed signers: Rachel Kim (Redwood) and Mike Hargrove (Brightline legal).

Timing: We can sign our side by end-of-day Fri 3/26 if Brightline can countersign by Tue 3/30. If Brightline needs more time for internal review, propose we lock in an interim mutual action plan and milestone dates.

Ben / Laura — please confirm attachments and that TIA language reflects our runtime data flows. Marcus, please add references to the subprocessor SOC2 portal in the DPA appendix.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Karthik / Rachel —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Our counsel reviewed Karthik's proposed language and we have a couple of minor counter-proposals (see attached Brightline_DPA_Redline_20260325.docx).

Execution: I've just created a DocuSign envelope and included the current DPA + SCCs + proposed UK addendum. Link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/EnvelopeID-XYZ123 (attached in this thread). Please review, initial the key pages and sign.

SOC2 evidence: I've asked our security ops team to send a list of the specific SUbprocessors where they want SOC2 reports. Ben, Marcus — can you surface the latest SOC2 snapshots from our vendor portal? We'll upload into the DocuSign folder if helpful.

On the telemetry paragraph: we accept Redwood's 30 day retention for troubleshooting but request that the DPA specify a notification obligation should telemetry be retained longer for incident response, with an explanation of scope and duration. Karthik, can you add that?

If we can get a countersigned DPA by Tue 3/30 we can clear procurement and include Redwood in our pilot by mid-April.

Best,
Sofia
